Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank.
8% = Tier 1 Rank-And-File
14% = Tier 2 Rank-And-File | Tier 1 Elite | Guardians
18% = Tier 3 Rank-And-File | Tier 2 Elite
26% = Tier 3 Elite | Minibosses | Bosses

Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on the <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] /> of the killed target:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 7.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 11%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Players: 16.25%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
